    Replacing the last pair of a ray tackle #

    Package the alternating same-length candidates in BGRS Figure 55. One candidate retains a hook tackle through its penultimate rho, deepens the following sigma, and installs a new irreducible hook. The dual candidate retains a cohook tackle through its penultimate sigma, deepens the following rho, and installs a new irreducible cohook.
